author: Top Gear
description:
Here at Top Gear we adore the Kimera EVO37, a Lancia restomod so good it’s our reigning Performance Car of the Year. But now Kimera has fiddled with it, giving it more power and more driven wheels. Has it been made better, or worse? 

🚗 Kimera EVO38
